status: declared by the pull request that closes #598 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: the published scarcity indicator and its 0.12 band are unchanged, the two columns below are off in every published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, and these rows are not added to the frozen shortlist of #567. The variants were built after seeing 2018-2025, so a pass here is not a confirmation (ruling on #567). The constants of the rolling level are #587's, written down once there and not re-tuned here; only the passers' own fitted parameters are fitted, on the judge's cadence
ruling: Eleonora, directive #598 (12 October 2026): put the rolling satiation distance of #596 into the row that passes tier 1 under the judge in force, where the risk-date part keeps the false alarms down. No hindsight regime labels (ruling on #515).

rolling_level.source: metadata/satiation_587.json, forms.rolling, read as written there and not re-tuned; repo_model.satiation.rolling_level

columns.distance_rule: the reserves-to-assets ratio the as-of rule reads at the row's own 16:00 decision minus the rolling level at that row (satiation.distance): negative below the level, positive above it
columns.hinge_rule: the percentage points by which that ratio is below the level, 0 at or above it (satiation.hinge_value): the distance that enters only below the level, the shape that passed tier 5 in #596
columns.source: satiation_distance_columns (metadata/sources_measurement.json; zero lag; off in every published declaration)
columns.guard: satiation.check_distance_no_future rebuilds a checked row from the panel cut at it and refuses (LookAheadError) a value that differs

risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll.label: (a) input
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll.rule: the passer risk_gbm+settle+h41 with the rolling distance as one extra input; everything else (the risk dates, the other features, the estimator, the settlement and H.4.1 timing) is the parent's

risk_gbm+settle+h41+hinge_roll.label: (b) gated input
risk_gbm+settle+h41+hinge_roll.rule: as (a), with the hinge of the distance in place of the signed distance: the input moves only below the rolling level

risk_gbm_base+settle+h41+hinge_roll.label: (c) as (b) on risk_gbm_base
risk_gbm_base+settle+h41+hinge_roll.rule: as (b) on risk_gbm_base, the other risk-date passer that passes tier 1 pooled

parents_declaration: metadata/risk_date_severity.json (unchanged: the risk dates, the features, the estimators), scored under the settlement and H.4.1 timing of metadata/announcement_dating.json (the 'both' arm)

rows.controls_reading: the two parent rows as scored on main, re-run in this measurement so that the pairs are on one run
rows.pairs_reading: each variant is paired with its parent row; the parents' own pairing against the references is reported beside them

references.controls_reading: the parents are the rows.controls; none is listed twice

reports.judge: the judge as declared under the weighted rule in force: tier 1 pooled and per lead, tiers 3 and 5, for every row beside the five risk-date passers, ngboost_laplace and the two benchmarks; each variant paired with its parent at +5 bp: the Brier difference at h = 1 to 5 and the onset recall difference, pooled and by regime and pressure-day type, 90% stationary-bootstrap intervals on shared resamples, the judge's seed
reports.calibration: predicted against realised rate of a pressure day at +5 bp, by regime and pressure-day type, pooled over h = 1 to 5 (the combined page's table)
reports.recall_by_year: onset recall by calendar year, with 2019 and 2025 called out
reports.gained_and_lost: the onsets a variant warns and its parent does not, and the reverse, by date (the combined page's only-row table, read against the parent)

unchanged: the judge, its bar, its cut-off rule, the weighted miss rule in force, the bootstrap, every published declaration, the information set, the published scarcity indicator and its 0.12 band, the frozen shortlist of #567 and the lockbox. A measurement only: nothing is published and no day after 2025-12-31 is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md).
